description: Test suite for session access and visibility functions in the sessions-access.ts module, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test group for a specific function or feature.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description and test logic.

methods.name: createAgentToAgentPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy object that determines allowed cross-agent interactions.

methods.description: Creates a guard to enforce session visibility rules.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines the effective visibility of session tools considering sandbox restrictions.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Resolves the default sandbox session tools visibility setting.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedSessionToolContext
methods.description: Resolves context for sandboxed session tools, including restriction flags.

methods.name: resolveSessionToolsVisibility
